frozenRules.mirrorAllowed: Use supplied left/right files rather than runtime improvisation where possible

themes.on-dark: Brighter aurora rim for dark/cinematic world backgrounds.
themes.on-light: Slightly stronger cool edge definition for white/light UI backgrounds.

poses.neutral-left: Default Home placement when Companion sits on right side and looks inward.
poses.neutral-right: Mirrored default when placed on left side.
poses.upright-left: Narrower/upright placement on dock, stone or compact vertical space.

portrait.note: Position so body rests on a real rock/dock/ground surface. Use separate shadow.

leftSideAlternative.rule: If placed left of the composition, use a right-facing/mirrored supplied sprite so it looks inward.
